g.text: M2: does the opportunity survive other batching choices?
All 100 formal runs; five paired repeats per contrast. Points / bars: run-level paired means / bootstrap 95% CI.
Positive is better. Within-session gate A/B; two mixed chunk sizes are one batching family. All use the same token-VTC.
